paragraphs: Veritone sells enterprise AI software that converts unstructured video, audio, and text into data for models and automated workflows, across commercial media, public sector, and talent acquisition lines. Its aiWARE platform is described as a customizable platform configured to an organization's needs.

For government, legal, and education organizations, Veritone iDEMS is a digital evidence management system made up of five Veritone applications. Veritone Investigate acts as a central hub where an agency stores digital evidence from disparate locations, and Veritone Redact automates redaction of sensitive data from audio, video, and image-based evidence. Veritone Tracker tracks persons of interest across videos using similarity scores rather than facial recognition, and Veritone Illuminate searches Electronically Stored Information for early case assessment. Veritone Contact collects and reports stop data for California AB 953 Racial Identity and Profiling Act (RIPA) compliance, and Veritone IDentify uses a booking database to identify subjects. The home page cites the Pasadena Police Department, which the company says cut two weeks of redaction time to two days.

Commercial products Digital Media Hub, Discovery, Commerce, and Data Refinery serve media and sports organizations with asset tagging, search, and licensing. Veritone Hire lets talent acquisition teams advertise jobs through a single vendor integrated with over 120 applicant tracking systems and over 2000 publishers. The company also states it renewed and expanded an exclusive global licensing agreement with CBS News and Stations.
